question: Can the recursive controller close the identity-gaming residuals left by meta-evolution v2 without inventing a duplicate diagnosis selector or allowing renamed contexts, renamed mutation families, or renamed evaluators to manufacture independence?
invariants: no v3 object grants scientific or method-promotion authority
the diagnosis/discriminator selector remains owned by the existing diagnosis/VOI lane; v3 consumes a decision receipt rather than inventing a second selector
context identity is content-bound and cannot be changed by relabelling a scope string
cross-context mutation credit requires an explicit transport witness
failure diversity is counted by content-bound mutation-family witness rather than family label
outer evaluator independence is content-and-lineage based rather than label inequality
candidate outcomes cannot construct the outer evaluator that certifies them
blocking validity precedes every soft Pareto comparison
all-invalid candidate sets produce no selectable frontier

cases.world: two differently named scopes have identical domain/problem-family/substrate/evaluator-epoch bindings
one evaluator-epoch digest differs while all other context fields match
operator earns positive evidence in context A and is queried in context B without a transport witness
operator earns evidence in context A and an explicit witness binds A->B for the same operator/layer
two failure epochs use different labels but identical target-layer/precondition/effect/falsifier content
three failure epochs differ on at least one normalized mechanic field and carry distinct evidence epochs
outer evaluator has a different display id but identical source/dependency/metric/benchmark/environment digests to the target evaluator
outer evaluator source is identical to target but benchmark label/hash differs
outer evaluator differs in content digest, binds exact subject/benchmark/environment, is frozen before candidate outcome, and candidate outcomes did not define it
all identities differ but outer assurance was frozen after candidate outcome
partial diagnosis spans REPRESENTATION and EVALUATOR and no decision-bearing discriminator receipt exists
registered discriminator receipt binds before/after diagnosis digests, evidence epoch, cost, and resolves to REPRESENTATION
receipt resolves a diagnosis digest different from the current portrait
best soft-QoI candidates are FAIL or CANNOT_CHECK and no PASS candidate exists
a PASS candidate is soft-dominated by a FAIL candidate

non_claims: This benchmark does not establish that v3 improves real research outcomes.
It does not establish optimal discriminator selection.
It does not establish scientific evaluator sufficiency.
It does not authorize Paper IV, V, or VI empirical claims.
